description: The escalation path for an unfair damage charge with official links: Australian state fair trading offices, the ACCC and AFCA, or in the US the card dispute route, state attorneys general, the FTC and CFPB, plus known company claim contacts. For a security deposit or rental bond, call get_damage_rules with the state instead (for example bond-ca or bond-nsw): a kept deposit isn't a card charge, so its path is a demand letter, then small claims court or the state tenancy tribunal.

country.description: AU for Australia, US for the United States. Defaults to the site that was called

state.description: Australian state or territory, e.g. NSW, VIC, QLD. Optional
